card.name: FDA before approved or cleared tests
card.fires_on: The word FDA (or Administration in Food and Drug Administration) right before a hyphen and words like approved or cleared, usually in phrases about using an FDA-approved test. Also weakly on 'was' before 'reviewed and approved' in ethics statements.

modes.label: FDA-approved test
modes.description: FDA right after 'using an' or 'using', ahead of -approved or -cleared test.
modes.example: Monitor AT activity using an<< FDA>>-cleared test and target AT activity

modes.label: Agency name or ethics review
modes.description: The end of the agency name, or a verb slot where approval by a body is about to be stated.
modes.example: The study<< was>> reviewed and approved by the research ethics committee

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting approve, approved and approval words next.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say something was approved or cleared by a regulator or review board.
